title: Donation Metric1 Monthly Rollup
dataSources: Volunteer shifts (`volunteer:shift`), donations (`donation:gift`), community events (`community:event`), mutual-aid requests (`mutualaid:request`), impact metrics (`impact:metric`).
app: Volunteering and community telemetry — volunteer-hours trackers, donation receipts, mutual-aid request boards, and community-event calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=donation:metric1
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as events, sum(value) as total_value by _time
| sort _time
description: Summarises monthly event volume and total value for donation metric1 (1) data.
value: Monthly rollups smooth daily noise and show seasonal shifts in personal activity.
implementation: Aggregate donation metric1 (1) events monthly and chart count plus total value.
visualization: Column chart of monthly events with total value overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It lays out how your donation metric1 (1) activity added up each month instead of day by day.
